_comment: 메인 언어. 서브 언어는 이 파일의 뜻을 그 나라 말로 옮긴다(직역 금지). 키를 더하면 모든 언어 파일에 같이 더한다 — build.py가 빠진 키를 알려 준다.
meta_title: Maeumlog — A cozy mood diary for iPhone and Android
meta_description: Maeumlog is a soft little mood diary. Tap Mongle, pick a mood, add a few words or a photo when you feel like it. No ads, ever. Made by Mauve Labs.
og_title: Maeumlog — A soft little diary for how you really feel
og_description: Tap Mongle, pick a mood, and you're done. No ads, no pressure.
hero_title: A soft little diary for how you really feel.
hero_lede: Tap Mongle, pick a mood, and you're done. Add a few words or a photo when you feel like it. No ads, no pressure.
hero_fine: Free to start · iPhone and Android
moods_sub: Five moods, five faces. On the hard days, Mongle doesn't judge — it just stays close.
mood_5_line: This will pass. Mongle's right here.
how_title: A minute a day is enough.
step_1_body: Pick a mood, tap a few feelings and what you did. Words are optional.
step_1_alt: Choosing a mood, feelings and activities in Maeumlog
step_2_body: Every day becomes a little cloud on your calendar. Patterns show up on their own.
step_2_alt: A month of moods on the Maeumlog calendar
step_3_body: Gentle stats show which days feel lighter — with friends, after a walk, over coffee.
step_3_alt: Maeumlog stats showing what lifts your mood
promise_2_line: Sign in only if you want a cloud backup.
promise_3_line: We don't sell your data to anyone.
soon_body: Stickers, washi tape, and little doodles are on the way — so your diary can look as cozy as it feels.
made_by: Maeumlog is made by Mauve Labs, a small, independent app studio.
